name: standardizeMissing
expr: B1 = standardizeMissing(X1, -99); B2 = standardizeMissing(X2, [-99 -88]); B3 = standardizeMissing(X3, -99); B4 = standardizeMissing(X4, NaN); B5 = standardizeMissing(X5, [NaN -99]); Bu = double(standardizeMissing(X8, 3)); Bi = double(standardizeMissing(X16, int16(-99))); Bs = double(standardizeMissing(Xs, single(-99)));
comment: standardizeMissing — replace nonstandard missing-value indicators with NaN. Covers: double/single/uint8/int16 inputs, scalar/vector indicator, matrix inputs, NaN-in-indicator (no-op since NaN!=NaN), mixed [NaN -99] indicator. Integer/logical types pass through unchanged (no missing concept) per MATLAB R2025b.
